verdict.rationale: First-party docs list speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and hands-free voice and video calls as features. A dedicated voice page says responses are read aloud sentence by sentence as they stream. Together these cover all three parts of the story: transcription, spoken replies, and live voice conversation. missing for 10: in-depth docs on STT/voice-note transcription and call mode beyond a one-line feature listing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the voice features.
